# Hanvi Events: Full Entity Information & Knowledge Sheet

## Business Identity & Entity Reference

- Official Name: Hanvi Events
- Alternate Names: Hanvi Events Kakinada, Hanvi Wedding Planners

- Primary Email: hello@hanvievents.com

## Service Delivery & Regional Reach

Hanvi Events operates its headquarters and fabrication dispatch from Kakinada, providing turnkey event planning and production across:
1. Kakinada (Headquarters & Central Studio)
2. Rajahmundry (Rajamahendravaram)
3. East Godavari District
4. Konaseema & Godavari Delta (Amalapuram, Mandapeta, Ravulapalem)
5. Samalkota, Pithapuram, Peddapuram, Annavaram, and Tuni
6. Pan-India and destination weddings upon custom brief

## Core Service Verticals

1. Luxury Telugu Wedding Planning: End-to-end ceremony orchestration including Nischithardham (Engagement), Pellikuthuru/Pellikoduku Haldi setups, Mehendi, Sangeet dance floors, Vedic Muhurtham, and grand receptions.
2. Sacred Mandap Architecture: Traditional South Indian temple bell setups, dense fresh jasmine (Mallepoovu) canopies, lotus uruli water bowls, and modern acrylic stages.
3. Milestone & Birthday Celebrations: 1st birthday theme universes, Barasala cradle ceremonies, half saree (Langa Voni) functions, and anniversary dinners.
4. Corporate Event Management: Staging, P3/P4 LED video walls, line-array audio engineering, product reveals, and annual day celebrations.

## Informational Guides & Direct Answers

- Wedding Planning Costs: Detailed analysis of budget factors (mandap volume, guest scale, venue dimensions, catering logistics).
- Telugu Wedding Checklist: Chronological Vedic ritual sequence from Nischithardham to Saptapadi and reception.
- Mandap Decor Guide: Floral cold preservation, overnight staging, and fire-safe havan kund management.
- Buyer's Guide: 5 essential verification criteria when selecting a wedding planner in Kakinada.

## Governance & Integrity Policy

In strict accordance with the SEO Evidence Register, this entity file excludes unverified numeric claims, fake rating stars, or stock photography passed off as proof. Real project case studies are published only when accompanied by original first-party media and written client permissions.
